skills.title: Being Inclusive and Respectful
skills.description: Pick ways to include and accept others. Choose how being kind and respectful helps everyone, including you.

skills.title: Effects of Cannabis and Other Drugs
skills.description: Sort the effects of cannabis, opioids, and other drugs and things like glue or gas. Pick how they can hurt the body and mind.

skills.title: Explicit Media and Real Life
skills.description: Pick how viewing sexually explicit media can give a wrong idea about relationships, gender, and bodies.

skills.title: Finding Mental Health Support
skills.description: Match problems with mental health or substance use to people and services that can help. Pick how to reach them.

skills.title: Thoughts, Emotions, and Actions
skills.description: See how thoughts, feelings, and actions connect. Sort positive and negative thinking and how each affects your mind.

skills.title: What Shapes Our Food Choices
skills.description: Sort things that affect what we eat, like allergies, cost, feelings, media, and culture. Pick healthy eating guidelines that fit.

skills.title: Hunger Cues and Growing Bodies
skills.description: Match what changes how hungry you are, like growth spurts, activity, and big portions. Pick eating guidelines that listen to your body.

skills.title: Handling Conflict Positively
skills.description: Pick ways to stay calm, listen, and speak up kindly in a conflict, in person or online.

skills.title: Safe Choices About Drugs
skills.description: Sort what can push a choice about alcohol, tobacco, cannabis, or vaping. Use decision steps to pick a safe choice, including saying no.

skills.title: Growing Up: Body, Friends, Feelings
skills.description: Sort the body, friend, and feeling changes of the teen years. Pick how knowing about them builds confidence.

skills.title: Respect and Consent in Relationships
skills.description: Pick respectful choices that show you understand consent. Use skills like knowing yourself and managing feelings.

skills.title: Healthy Eating and Active Living
skills.description: Match how eating well and being active together help your body and mind. Pick ways to encourage others to do both.

skills.title: Safe When Caring for Others
skills.description: Pick safe choices when babysitting, staying home alone, or cooking. Choose what to do in emergencies like fire, allergic reactions, or bullying.

skills.title: Stereotypes and Fair Thinking
skills.description: Spot stereotypes about gender, race, culture, abilities, and more. Pick ways to answer them and how they affect people.
